evals.prompt: Create repository knowledge docs for the fixture repo in evals/files/create-basic. Keep the output compact and evidence-backed.
evals.expected_output: A minimal knowledge set that creates only documents whose value tests pass, uses source and manifest evidence for current-state claims, and reports unknowns instead of guessing.
assertions: AGENTS.md and CODE-MAP.md are created because their document-contract value tests pass
Created documents satisfy the document-contract value tests instead of creating placeholders
CONTEXT.md is not created when candidate terms are safely recoverable from obvious source and test names
Runnable commands are traced to package.json scripts before publication
Domain and source-navigation facts cite behavior-bearing source or focused tests
The final report includes mode, changed files, decisive evidence, unknowns, and checks when applicable

evals.prompt: Refresh the existing knowledge docs in evals/files/refresh-stale after source paths changed. Preserve supported human-authored guidance and correct stale current-state claims.
evals.expected_output: A refresh that limits changes to affected stale facts, keeps supported local guidance, corrects stale paths, verifies and retains current commands from repository evidence, and reports the baseline or lack of reliable baseline.
assertions: Supported human-authored guidance remains intact
Stale paths are corrected or removed only after checking current repository evidence
The diff avoids unrelated wording, ordering, or formatting churn
The report identifies the refresh baseline used or states that no reliable baseline existed

evals.prompt: Perform a CODE-MAP-only refresh for evals/files/code-map-only so navigation points match the current source tree. Leave all other knowledge documents unchanged.
evals.expected_output: Only CODE-MAP.md changes; AGENTS.md and ARCHITECTURE.md remain byte-for-byte unchanged while stale navigation entries are updated from source evidence.
assertions: No knowledge document except CODE-MAP.md is modified
CODE-MAP.md maps the HTTP API to src/api/http.ts, the sync worker to src/workers/sync.ts, and the focused test to test/sync.test.ts
Every retained CODE-MAP.md link resolves with exact path case
The report explicitly confirms CODE-MAP-only isolation was checked

evals.prompt: Refresh architecture knowledge for evals/files/conflicted-intent. Existing docs describe a target event stream, but current source implements synchronous HTTP calls.
evals.expected_output: Current behavior is documented from source evidence, contradicted target architecture remains only as labelled unresolved intent, and the conflict is reported as a stale or unresolved claim.

evals.prompt: Create repository knowledge docs for evals/files/insufficient-evidence.

evals.prompt: Create a dedicated coding-agent knowledge base for the guild leaderboard functional module in evals/files/module-discovery-only. Use the temporary delivery summary as a discovery source, but the final knowledge must remain self-contained after that file is deleted and must not name or link it.
evals.expected_output: A module knowledge set that independently verifies current behavior, transfers only durable compatible rationale, treats external state as a prerequisite or unknown, and exposes production runtime-boundary gaps hidden by hand-built test doubles.
assertions: No created or modified knowledge file names, links, cites, or directs readers to the temporary delivery summary, and all knowledge remains understandable with that input removed

The declared composition root and concrete store independently prove that consecutive positive writes report cumulative totals; the stale 500 threshold and planned monthly board are not published as current behavior
Maximum-score retention is treated as repository-unverifiable external state, and only the compatible cumulative-convergence rationale is transferred from the temporary input

The region-migration owner passage traces its reachable caller and does not claim externally observed report-before-delete ordering: in that flow, rather than only in a shared transport summary, it distinguishes queued report from direct delete, local invocation from remote application, and the stubbed call-order test from production transport behavior

The member-score read contract is reported as currently defective: the reachable composed path hydrates a Map that the consumer reads with object property access and Object.keys, producing zero scores and missing departed contributors despite the passing plain-object unit fixture

The maintenance-refresh owner passage preserves the delete and report completion layers and fallbacks rather than relying on a shared transport summary, and describes the operation as best-effort because its composed path can return a score after delete failure is swallowed and report is only queued

Only value-tested module documents and one minimal module-map entry contain new guild-leaderboard knowledge; root architecture, root code map, product source, tests, and the temporary input remain unchanged
